bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New builds enhance user experience across Canary, Dev, and Beta channels.
Gaming Copilot Beta Launch - AI-powered recommendations and insights are now available for Windows PC gamers.
AI Datacenter Expansion - New AI datacenters announced in the US and UK to support advanced workloads.
Microsoft Defender ROI - A recent study shows a 242% ROI for organizations using Microsoft Defender over three years.
Windows 365 Enhancements - New features improve cloud productivity and security for users across various roles.
Microsoft Fabric Innovations - New capabilities announced to enhance data organization and AI readiness.
